risk_note: RV2 by path (ledger, settlement). Read-only GET /v1/earnings/summary (BR-FUND-25, BR-INV-16/17): self / share columns give paid_count, estimate and credited for today / yesterday / this month / last month (+08:00, injected Clock, @couli/domain); referral column gives only this / last month estimate and credited totals (direct + indirect, all platforms), null when earnings.dashboard.referral_visible is off; earnings.dashboard.enabled off returns 30701. Counts and estimates bucket by orders.paid_at; estimates reuse the settlement pending-earnings share rules (effective commission settle-first, floor per order and per role via packages/money). Credited = −Σ amount_fen of the caller's USER_BALANCE available REBATE / SHARE / REFERRAL_CREDIT entries by voucher accounting_date. One read-only REPEATABLE READ transaction; no ledger write path touched. Contract: getEarningsSummary no longer planned; generated route-schemas.gen.ts and planned-operations.gen.ts regenerated. No migration.
